status: design-reference; agent may adapt to a Godot Resource/JSON loader without changing mission content

missions.title: The Red House Delivery
missions.short: Deliver 3 apples to the RED HOUSE.
missions.goal: Take exactly three apples from the marked market crate to RED HOUSE.
hints: Find the apples at the market.
Pick up three red apples from the marked crate.
Follow the glowing path to RED HOUSE.

missions.title: Workshop Supplies
missions.short: Take 5 wood and 3 stones to the WORKSHOP.
missions.goal: Collect five logs from grove and three stones from stone patch; submit all eight at workshop.
hints: The workshop needs wood and stone.
Find five logs in the grove and three stones near the rocks.
Bring all eight objects to the workshop sign.

missions.title: Build the Bridge
missions.short: Make the bridge with 3 supports and 4 planks.
missions.goal: Snap three supports into lower sockets, then four planks across bridge upper sockets.
hints: The bridge needs supports first.
Place three square supports into the lower glowing spaces.
Now add four long planks to cross the water.

missions.title: Market Basket
missions.short: Buy 2 bread and 1 milk for TOWN HALL.
missions.goal: Use separate 12-coin job budget: 2 bread costing 3 each + 1 milk costing 4; total 10, change 2; deliver to Town Hall.
hints: Read the list at the market.
Choose two bread and one milk. Watch the total.
You should spend ten of the twelve job coins.

missions.title: Village Road Rally
missions.short: Drive through numbered gates 1, 2, 3, 4.
missions.goal: Drive through all four wide checkpoint arches in order; elapsed time only for optional reward.
hints: Follow the bridge to the meadow course.
Drive the yellow van through gate 1, then 2, then 3, then 4.
You can finish as slowly as you like.

missions.title: Two-Stop Post
missions.short: Deliver two BLUE parcels and one ORANGE parcel.
missions.goal: Deliver 2 blue parcels to Red House and 1 orange parcel to Workshop, with clear address labels.
hints: Collect the parcels at the post counter.
BLUE goes to RED HOUSE. ORANGE goes to WORKSHOP.
Check both address labels before dropping off.

missions.title: Fix the Swings
missions.short: Build 2 swings with 4 ropes and 2 seats.
missions.goal: Use 4 rope pieces and 2 seats on two swing frames. Both swings function after completion.
hints: Each swing uses two ropes and one seat.
Two swings need four ropes and two seats.
Snap each part into the highlighted frame.

missions.title: Park Planner
missions.short: Decorate the green with 20 job coins.
missions.goal: Choose and place a bench, flowerbed and lamp for 6+4+9=19 from a dedicated budget of 20; change 1.
hints: The park has twenty coins to spend.
Bench costs six, flowers four, lamp nine.
Place each item inside the green outline. You should have one coin left.

missions.title: Race the Clock (Bonus)
missions.short: Finish the course; 75 seconds is a bonus challenge.
missions.goal: Complete the four checkpoint course; optional 75-second goal for bonus coins; time never prevents job completion.
hints: Complete the course in any time.
Look for the broad alternate road through the meadow.
Finish under 75 seconds only if you want the extra bonus.

missions.title: Home Sweet Home
missions.short: Furnish your house: table, 2 chairs and plant.
missions.goal: Buy and snap one table at 8, two chairs at 5 each, one plant at 3; total cost 21 from owned coins, with free basic furniture fallback if necessary.
hints: Visit the house and open the furnishing menu.
Place one table, two chairs and a plant.
You can move furniture after placing it.

missions.title: Meet the Neighbours
missions.short: Read names and deliver 3 welcome cards.
missions.goal: Talk to Ada, Ollie and Fern; match each greeting card to its name.
hints: Look for name labels above villagers.
Say the name before handing over a card.
Find Ada at the market, Ollie near town hall and Fern at the green.
missions.worldEffect: Three villagers wave and become available for follow-up jobs

missions.title: Bakery Busy Day
missions.short: Help Ada make 3 orders using the right amounts.
missions.goal: Read 3 customer orders and count the correct bread and cake items.
hints: Start with the picture cards.
Count the buns for each customer.
Check the total before serving.

missions.title: Lost Library Books
missions.short: Find 4 books and put them on the right shelves.
missions.goal: Collect labelled books and match each to its shelf.
hints: Search near the village paths.
Read the big word on each cover.
Match the cover word to the shelf word.
learning: read SUN, MOON, TREE and STAR

missions.title: Road Sign Rescue
missions.short: Put 3 direction signs in the correct places.
missions.goal: Fix signs pointing to MARKET, WORKSHOP and GREEN.
hints: Match each sign to its coloured socket.
Look at the arrow and the landmark.
Try the direction again if it is wrong.
missions.worldEffect: Missing road direction signs become visible

missions.title: Garden Patterns
missions.short: Plant a red-blue pattern across 6 flowerbeds.
missions.goal: Complete the repeating flower pattern RED, BLUE, RED, BLUE, RED, BLUE.
hints: Look at the first two flowers.
Repeat the same two colours.
Six beds make three pairs.
missions.worldEffect: Community garden blooms with six flowerbeds

missions.title: The Delivery Round
missions.short: Drive 3 parcels to the right villagers.
missions.goal: Load parcels for Ada, Pip and Ivy and deliver to matching names.
hints: Read the name on each parcel.
Check the mini-map or road signs.
Stop near each recipient and press E.
missions.worldEffect: Village notice board displays completed delivery route

missions.title: Market Day Maths
missions.short: Fill 3 shopping lists without exceeding 20 job coins.
missions.goal: Buy 2 bread, 1 milk and 2 apples from a separate job purse.
hints: Bread costs 3. Milk costs 4. Apples cost 2 each.
Add each price as you shop.
You have 20 job coins. Spend 14 and keep 6.

missions.title: Mechanic’s Toolbox
missions.short: Fix Pip’s vehicle with 2 tyres, 1 lamp and 1 battery.
missions.goal: Find four repair parts, then fit them in the correct sequence.
hints: Inspect the broken car first.
Two tyres go on before the lamp.
Fit the battery last.
missions.worldEffect: Pip’s car becomes driveable after repair

missions.title: The Grand Rally
missions.short: Drive 6 gates on the new long circuit beside Pip.
missions.goal: Drive six numbered gates; finish to win, with an optional time medal.
hints: Follow big signs 1 to 6.
Wide corners are safer than sharp turns.
There is no required time limit.
missions.worldEffect: New rally podium and trophy appear

missions.title: Village Festival
missions.short: Prepare the village festival with decorations and invitations.
missions.goal: Deliver 3 invitations, place 2 tables and hang 3 lanterns.
hints: First invite the neighbours.
Then put the tables in the marked spots.
Finally hang all three lanterns.
missions.worldEffect: Second chapter festival, lanterns and music unlock
